comments.author: @businessbreakdowns-i9e
comments.text: The 'profit centers not airlines' framing blew my mind - the loyalty programs being worth more than the airlines themselves explains so much. Collateralizing the miles during the crisis was genius-level financial engineering. Incredible deep-dive as always.

comments.author: @jburron
comments.text: LAX-ORD-SFO is a direct flight. Direct flights can have stops. Non-stop flights do not have stops. Big difference when booking. 10:18

comments.author: @tombuecking4872
comments.text:
In 1986 when I headed the CPAir loyalty program I demonstrated to the airline at that time that the loyalty program “CPAIR TRAVEL BONUS PROGRAM “ was making more money than the airline. 
In 2001 working for a small loyalty consultant company I convinced the owner to buy the current MBNA Loyalty program from BofA. 
I’m surprised that it took Air Canada so long to figure this out. 
Hello companies with loyalty programs. You’re not running a loyalty discount program you’re running a money machine.
